args.summary: Following the deploy of v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. As remediation, the service was rolled back to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all production regions. Rollback verified: service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate reduced to ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause of the health check failures is identified.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions — 18% error rate. The most recent version that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: the service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the health check failures, the rollback, and verification — the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: the v2.3.1 release had a prior unhealthy rc (v2.3.1-rc) in staging as well, so this version should be fully root-caused before attempting any redeploy.
